title: Foreclosure auction scheduled for Berrien County property in Niles on October 8
text:
← Back to the wire
Foreclosure auction scheduled for Berrien County property in Niles on October 8
A foreclosure auction for a Niles property in Berrien County is set for October 8. The sheriff’s office notes that sale details may change and results will not be posted. The auction will be held at the courthouse in Saint Joseph.
A foreclosure auction for a property in Berrien County is scheduled to take place on October 8. The property, located at 1822 S. 3rd St., Niles, MI 49120, is listed with an amount of $105,103.16.
The Berrien County Sheriff’s Office reports that it is not responsible for the accuracy of the foreclosure information provided. The data is gathered and presented by private parties who prepare foreclosures. Properties listed are subject to change without notice, and the status of a sale can change at any time due to cancellation, adjournment, or other reasons. This means that a scheduled sale may not occur as indicated.
Effective Thursday, February 19, all sheriff’s sales will be moved to Thursdays at 11:00 a.m. in the 2nd floor jury room at the courthouse in Saint Joseph, Michigan. Sales results will not be posted.
"The Berrien County Sheriff’s Office is not responsible for the accuracy of the foreclosure information shown here. The data provided here is gathered and presented by private parties who prepare foreclosures. Properties listed are subject to change without notice. The status of a sale can change at any time due to cancellation, adjournment or other reasons. This means that a scheduled sale may not occur as indicated below. Sales results will not be posted," according to the Berrien County Sheriff’s Office.
Additional information and updates regarding foreclosure sales can be found on the Berrien County website.
